sources: Average height of German men by birth decade, 1810–1980 (soldiers, conscripts and other samples): University of Tübingen / Baten & Blum (2015), 'Human Height' (Clio Infra), via Our World in Data (owid-datasets 'Human Height - University of Tuebingen (2015)'). 1810: 167.8 cm, 1850: 163.8 cm, 1900: 169.2 cm, 1950: 176.8 cm, 1980: 180.5 cm (180.5 - 163.8 = 16.7 cm).

Explanation (nutrition, sanitation, disease in childhood): e.g. NCD Risk Factor Collaboration (2016), 'A century of trends in adult human height', eLife; Baten & Blum (2015). Men only; data by year of birth.
